description: Presidential Secretariat - Appointing Wijesekera Arachchige Tillekeratne Ratnayake Esqr. and Hewahettige Sumanapala Esqr. as the Commissioners of the Commission of Inquiry in addition to other 03 appointed Commissioners
categorisation: This gazette content involves the appointment of commissioners to a Commission of Inquiry (specifically Wijesekera Arachchige Tillekeratne Ratnayake and Hewahettige Sumanapala) by the President. This falls under judicial/law enforcement matters as it pertains to the establishment and composition of an official commission of inquiry, which is a judicial or quasi-judicial body tasked with investigating specific matters (in this case, disappearances and abductions). The content does not primarily concern government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3) or other specialized categories like land, commercial, or electoral matters.
